# Problems of the optimal suite for which PDDL Symmetries reported an abstraction class.
# Generated by running the pipeline up to the choice of the class (reading the
# task, symmetry discovery, and _select_abstraction) on every problem of SUITE,
# with the 300-second symmetry limit and a 400-second cap on the whole check.
# Once a run has been collected, regenerate it as for sat/symmetries:
#   awk -F, '$3=="abs-fd" && $4!="no symmetries" && NR>1 {print $1"/"$2}' results.csv | sort -u
# mystery/prob07 and mystery/prob18 are left out: PDDL Symmetries reports that
# neither has a relaxed solution.
# openstacks-strips/p28, p29 and trucks-strips/p29, p30 are left out: the check
# reached its 400-second cap there, so whether they have a class is unknown.
